labels.name: Melanocyte
labels.function: Pigment factory of the basal layer, about 1 per 10 basal cells

labels.name: Dendritic process
labels.function: Arm that carries pigment granules to up to 40 keratinocytes

labels.name: Melanosome
labels.function: Specialized lysosome that packages the pigment for transfer

labels.name: Basal keratinocyte
labels.function: Basal-layer epithelial cell, about ten for each pigment cell

labels.name: Supranuclear melanin cap
labels.function: Umbrella over the DNA that blocks UV damage

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Layer where pigment cells normally reside and PIH pigment lies

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Deeper connective tissue layer below the basement line

labels.name: Dermal melanocyte
labels.function: Stuck during neural crest migration; blue-gray infant patch

labels.name: Phenylalanine
labels.function: Starting amino acid of the whole pathway

labels.name: Tyrosine
labels.function: Amino acid oxidized at the slowest, controlling step

labels.name: Tyrosinase
labels.function: Rate-limiting enzyme; its defect causes OCA1

labels.name: DOPA
labels.function: Intermediate turned into pigment through several steps

labels.name: TYRP1
labels.function: Enzyme in the later steps; its defect causes OCA3

labels.name: Melanosome
labels.function: Specialized lysosome that holds and exports the pigment

labels.name: Eumelanin
labels.function: Pigment giving brown or black color

labels.name: Pheomelanin
labels.function: Pigment giving yellow or red color

labels.name: Membrane-associated transporter protein
labels.function: Transport protein whose defect causes OCA4

labels.name: Albinism

labels.function: Pigment cells lost; associated with thyroid disease

labels.name: Lymphocytes
labels.function: Immune cells that attack the basal pigment cells

labels.name: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
labels.function: Excess epidermal pigment driven by cytokines

labels.name: Dermal melanocytosis
labels.function: Pigment cells arrested deep to the basement line

labels.name: Acanthosis nigricans
labels.function: Velvety plaque linked to insulin resistance
